skills.name: Variables and types
skills.description: Declaring variables and reasoning about primitive types like integers, floats, booleans, and strings.
question_forms: determine the type or value of a variable after an assignment
predict the result of a type conversion

skills.name: Expressions and operators
skills.description: Evaluating arithmetic, comparison, and boolean expressions, including operator precedence.
question_forms: evaluate an expression involving multiple operators
determine the boolean result of a compound condition

skills.name: Conditionals
skills.description: Using if/elif/else branches to select which statements execute.
question_forms: trace which branch of an if/elif/else executes
predict the output of code with nested conditionals

skills.name: Loops
skills.description: Using for and while loops to repeat statements, including tracking loop state across iterations.
question_forms: trace the value of a variable across loop iterations
predict the output of a for or while loop

skills.name: Function definition and call
skills.description: Defining a function and calling it, distinguishing the function body from the call site, typically writing bodies that branch internally.
question_forms: write a function that branches internally to produce a required output
trace the execution of a function call

skills.name: Parameters and return values
skills.description: Passing arguments into a function and using its return value, including multiple return paths.
question_forms: determine the return value of a function given its arguments
trace a function with multiple return statements

skills.name: Recursion
skills.description: Writing a recursive function with a correct base case and reasoning about the call stack.
question_forms: write a recursive function with a correct base case
trace the call stack of a recursive function

skills.name: Arrays and lists
skills.description: Indexing, slicing, and mutating list-like sequences, including off-by-one boundaries.
question_forms: determine the result of indexing or slicing a list
identify an off-by-one error in a loop over a list

skills.name: String manipulation
skills.description: Slicing, searching, and building strings, treating them as immutable sequences.
question_forms: determine the result of a string slicing or searching operation
build a string through concatenation across a loop

skills.name: Hash maps
skills.description: Using key-value maps for lookup, counting, and grouping, including handling missing keys and using strings as keys.
question_forms: use a hash map to count or group items
handle a missing key when looking up a value

skills.name: Linked lists
skills.description: Traversing and mutating a singly linked list by following and rewriting node references, contrasted against array-based storage.
question_forms: traverse a linked list to find or count nodes
insert or remove a node by rewriting node references

skills.name: Searching
skills.description: Implementing linear and binary search and reasoning about when each applies.
question_forms: trace the steps of a binary search on a sorted array
determine whether linear or binary search applies to a given input

skills.name: Sorting
skills.description: Implementing a comparison-based sort, including a recursive divide-and-conquer sort, and tracing its behavior over a partially ordered list.
question_forms: trace the steps of a sorting algorithm on a partially ordered list
identify the divide-and-conquer steps of a recursive sort

skills.name: Tracing execution
skills.description: Mentally executing code line by line, including across function calls, to predict program state and output.
question_forms: predict the output of a code snippet by tracing it line by line
trace program state across a function call
